text.tspan: Project HTTP host ports 8090-8094 map to
internal port 8000. Devices and seed publish none.
Bookings absent: persistence in deployed setup.
Choose lowest level with peak <900 ppm.
If none qualifies, return maximum level 3.
Plan: level, predicted peak and heating target.
Room inputs: occupancy and reached states.
Actuator: state, target, motion and fault.
Sensors: lag, noise, faults; also write to BuildSim.
Counters: HTTP truth, not automatically MQTT.
Reactive control continues if history/plans fail.
Plans expire. Other services also use SimClock.
Truth boundary: convention on a shared network.
Rejected linear model is not deployed;
